documents.title: Reply To Clarification On Significant Increase In The Volume Of Security Across Exchanges In Recent Past Sought By BSE Limited
Clarification sought from DMCC Speciality Chemicals Ltd
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Reply To Clarification On Significant Increase In The Volume Of Security Across Exchanges In Recent Past Sought By NSE Limited.

analysis.summary: DMCC Speciality Chemicals reported its Q4 and FY26 financial performance, highlighting top-line growth driven by higher raw material prices which were passed on to customers. Management discussed severe disruptions in the sulfur supply chain stemming from the Middle East crisis and Gulf of Hormuz transit issues, as well as boron ore supply issues from Turkey in the first half of the year. Working capital requirements and short-term borrowings expanded significantly due to higher raw material and stock values. Management noted that European markets continue to struggle, while new markets are being developed in Latin America, Japan, Korea, and China. Management reported a flat top line of INR 126 crores for Q2 FY26, which was higher by 25% year-on-year, while profit before tax stood at INR 8.28 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the European market continues to struggle, leading to reduced speciality chemical business in Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: Europe continues to struggle. So, our speciality chemical business has reduced in Europe, but it is improving in other parts of the world.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that until the gas situation becomes normal in consuming centers like Morbi, demand for non-boric acid products will not return.
demand_outlook.quote: And until the gas situation becomes normal, the demand will not come back.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that European consumption has come down, resulting in reduced exports to the region.
demand_outlook.quote: On the positive side, and that is not because of competition or anything, but it's more because the consumption in Europe has come down.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that end-use demand for sulfuric acid is growing due to government policy supporting increased domestic fertilizer production.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic market is also growing because the main end use of sulfuric acid is fertilizers and the policy right now by the government is to increase the domestic production of fertilizers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the overall situation has been better than the previous two years, with the major exception of the European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: And overall, the situation has been better than the previous 2 years with one major exception being the European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that consumption of materials in Europe has come down because European chemical companies reduced production due to increased energy and other costs.
demand_outlook.quote: You all know how Europe has struggled with the increase in cost, particularly that of energy and several chemical companies have reduced their production in Europe, and there is really not much expansion happening. So we have lost some of our exports to Europe as well, not to competition, but basically the consumption of those materials in Europe has come down.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that apart from positive changes in domestic consumption and good growth in the boron business, export sales (mostly specialty chemicals) took a hit due to EU market conditions.
demand_outlook.quote: So apart from positive changes in the domestic consumption in India and particularly in the boron business where we have had some good growth, the export sales and that constitutes mostly Specialty Chemicals has taken a hit because of the EU market conditions.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a solar power plant at the end of the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also commissioned at the end of the quarter a solar power plant.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that about INR 10 crores of capex is approved for the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: About INR 10 crores is our CAPEX approved for this year and it will be around the same level next year unless we do some other projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that all major planned investments have been made and they are not envisaging any major capex at this time.
capex_expansion.quote: And all our major investments that we had planned have been made. So we are not envisaging any major CAPEX at this time.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they have a plan of about INR 10 crores to INR 15 crores, but nothing major compared to the Dahej expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: We have a plan of about INR 10 crores to INR 15 crores, but nothing major compared to what we have done, the major expansion at Dahej, which happened over the last few years.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that absolute margins were maintained despite a turbulent supply chain situation.
margins_costs.quote: Mathematically, it looks in percentage terms as if the margin has come down. But in absolute terms, even in a quite turbulent and difficult supply chain situation, we were able to maintain the absolute margin.

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that incremental working capital lines carry an interest rate in the range of 8.75% to 9%.
margins_costs.quote: So, it's about 9%, 8.75% to 9% in that range is the percentage of interest.

margins_costs.claim: Sulfur costs have increased for all consumers and producers of sulfur-based sulfuric acid.
margins_costs.quote: Sulfur costs have gone up, not only for us, but for all consumers of sulfur and producers of sulfur-based sulfuric acid.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that full year EBITDA margins were about 13.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For the full year, we've had EBITDA margins of about 13.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that a previous year quarter included a pre-tax profit of about INR 8 crores on the sale of some investments, which needs to be factored in when comparing quarters.
margins_costs.quote: If you compare it to the previous year, it may not seem much of an increase, but I just point out that in the last year and particularly Q4 of last year, we had a profit on the sale of some investments, which was to the tune of about INR 8 crores before tax. So that needs to be factored in when you are comparing last quarter -- the same quarter of last year with this year's Q4.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that an unusual jump in sulfur prices of about 40% across the last few months caused a compression in EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: So I think 40% or so was a change in the price just across the last few months.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that both the Dahej and Roha plants have an installed sulfuric acid capacity of approximately 350 tons per day each.
orders_capacity.quote: Almost 350 tons per day around that for Dahej as well.

orders_capacity.claim: The commodity business operates at between 95% and 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: So, our commodity business, which is sulfuric acid and allied products that operates at more than 90% capacity, I would say, between 95% to 100% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The specialty chemical business operates at or slightly below 50% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: The specialty chemical business is at or maybe slightly below 50%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that bulk chemical plants are running at practically full capacity (90% to 95%).
orders_capacity.quote: So in the bulk chemicals, we are practically running at full capacity. So even last year, we would have run at 90% or 95% capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that capacity utilization in the Specialty Chemicals business is between 50% to 60% on average.
orders_capacity.quote: I would say we are between 50% to 60% in our Specialty Chemicals business in terms of capacity utilization.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company has reduced its debt and will continue to do so.
capital_allocation.quote: We have reduced our debt, as you can probably see from the balance sheet, and we will continue to do so.

capital_allocation.claim: Management confirmed that working capital requirements will increase to support the boron business.
capital_allocation.quote: You are exactly right. We will need more working capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that about 50% of global sulfur trade flows through the Gulf of Hormuz, and the Middle East crisis affected sulfur availability and prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Most of the sulfur traded flows through the Gulf of Hormuz. In fact, about 50% of global sulfur trade is through Hormuz. So that has affected availability and therefore the price of the product not only in India but also in other parts of the world including China.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that in the first half of the financial year, production was lost due to disruptions in boron ore supply from Turkey.
risks_headwinds.quote: The first half of the year, we lost a lot of production because of disruption in supply of the boron ore from our main supplier in Turkey.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management reported that the Maharashtra government has not yet transferred the Nalimbi land back to the company's name despite a favorable Supreme Court verdict.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Maharashtra government has still not transferred the land back to our name in spite of the court order.

risks_headwinds.claim: A change of raw material distributor for the boron business resulted in a lead time increase to nearly 90 to 100 days and delayed shipments.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now we have to buy ex-Turkey and pay advance before the material is shipped. So, that changes the time for arrival of the vessel by nearly 90 days to 100 days.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that European manufacturing and chemical industry revival looks difficult under the current energy and industrial policy scenario.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, a revival under current policy scenario to me looks difficult, but I'm certainly no expert on European chemical industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that one of the potential threats to profitability is the upcoming commissioning of a large copper smelter in Kutch later this year, which is expected to put downward pressure on the sulfuric acid market.
risks_headwinds.quote: One of the potential threats to our profitability, as mentioned in the report, is the upcoming commissioning of a large copper smelter in Kutch, and that is expected to happen sometime later this year. Exact dates have not been announced. But that is expected to put some downward pressure on the sulfuric acid market

management_commitments.claim: Management stated there are plans to increase R&D intensity, and results will be visible in coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: But we do have some plans for increasing this, and you will see that in the coming quarters.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the boron business to recover and return to normal operations from the second half of the current quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And we look forward to the boron business recovering from the second half of the current quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that products recently launched will get fully accepted in the current year, and they will develop new products to take up next year for commercialization.
management_commitments.quote: And we expect that the products which we've recently launched will get fully accepted in this current year. And in this current year, we will develop some new products, which we'll take up in the next year for commercialization.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
